name: RC-B10-0533/2025 – After § 9 – Am 14
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of the war and the humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan
part_text: 9 f. Calls for a comprehensive debt moratorium and, where appropriate, the cancellation of Sudan’s external debt, and for a halt to the austerity-driven conditionalities of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank, which undermine public services, social protection, food sovereignty and climate resilience; insists that any future economic support must prioritise social justice, public health, education, sustainable agriculture, land rights and environmentally just reconstruction;
